scope: Read-only current-native observation of bounded legacy server requests after an exact same-target freeze.

Cross-clock ordering does not require a lease start to precede application-side frozenAt. Future observation or malformed/foreign/duplicate slot metadata is rejected.

Actual separate-transaction cleanup after a slot read can make the first count conservative; the following observation is zero. Owned executor terminates.
Read failures and original cancellation/interruption propagate without retry. Late offboarding, admission budget expiry and an interrupted thread reject the read while preserving the frozen owner.
